item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":3,"rationale":"The President presently makes the statutory national-security determination that legally authorizes use of the cited funds; later administration merely implements that determination.","evidence":"it is hereby determined that the use of funds, available under said Act, for the purpose of carrying out the program of asylum for refugees from Hungary"},{"segment_id":"2","code":1,"rationale":"Executive agencies are assigned implementation, expenditure, and reimbursement-coordination responsibilities, with the particular actions and amounts left to later requests, interagency agreement, and budget approval.","evidence":"are authorized and directed to take such action and make such expenditures as may be necessary"},{"segment_id":"3","code":0,"rationale":"The first sentence expresses a nonbinding desire, while the second requests that an official transmit statutory notices to congressional committee chairs; neither governs agencies in a legally consequential way.","evidence":"is requested on my behalf to give appropriate notices"}]}
